actions.description: Move the tool centre point to a Cartesian position and orientation in a named frame. The endpoint solves inverse kinematics; an unreachable target is rejected before motion.

inputs.description: Target position of the machine control point in mm
inputs.name: position

actions.name: move_to

actions.description: Drive axes to their declared home position or reference switch, establishing the coordinate reference needed by other motion capabilities.

inputs.description: Axes to home individually; omit for the all-axes routine
inputs.name: axes

actions.name: home

actions.description: Set the X/Y/Z tool offset of a configured tool with the upstream G10 command
actions.name: set_tool_offset

outputs.description: Tool index the offsets were applied to
outputs.name: tool_index

facts.text: Machine.gcode() posts each G-code command to http://{address}/machine/code
get_position() asks the Duet for M114 and returns the machine control point in mm keyed by axis
move_to() selects absolute positioning and calls _move_xyzev with x, y, z, e, v and the speed s
_move_xyzev formats each coordinate with two decimals and sends a G0 command; wait=True follows with M400
set_tool_offset() requires a tool index, formats each offset with two decimals and sends a G10 command
home_all() parks the active tool when one is selected, sends G28 and marks X, Y, Z and U homed
home_z() asks the operator to confirm that the deck is free before sending G28 Z
The axis travel range is read from the Duet object model M409 move.axes as a min/max pair per axis
Jubilee has four axes by default: the X, Y and Z dimensional axes and the toolchanger U axis
By default the machine uses millimetres
The demo machine configuration sets software axis limits M208 X-13.75:313.75 Y-44:341 Z0:300 and M208 U0:200
Tool offsets shift the usable coordinate range: a tool with a Z offset of 50 moves from Z-50 to Z250 while the firmware keeps motion inside the 300x300x300 mm build volume
The clone documents the tool-ball crash trigger as an emergency stop that disables the steppers and resets the board, the same as the M112 G-code
